ownerDirective.speaker: Governor
ownerDirective.exactText: i'm the governmor of the minecraft world and I've come to cut red tape
ownerDirective.interpretation: The finite Ravensreach crew-return bridge and south crew platform are delegated to the implementation team; hard safety is not waived.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact south crew-side platform, terminal return bridge, containment wall, and clearance around retained north/south passive rails.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: No public platform, passenger boarding/service, vehicle, power, signal, or public route is authorized.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Exact state/inverse, retained directional rail/support proofs, and independent QA are mandatory.
Fresh immutable source and exact preflight immediately precede mutation.
Forward and reverse parser validation is strict-noop.
Exact block-entity and fresh live-entity clearance are mandatory.
Execution is journaled; failure invokes exact reverse rollback.
Fresh post capture, rollback poststate proof, and independent QA precede acceptance.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: Failure blocks only this exact crew-return connection.
